mapper.select: SELECT a.ApptID as apptId, a.UserID as userId, a.PetID as petId, a.StoreID as storeId, a.EmpID as empId, a.ApptTime as apptTime, a.ApptStatus as apptStatus, a.CreateTime as createTime, p.PetName as petName, u.UserName as userName, u.Phone as userPhone, s.StoreName as storeName, e.EmpName as empName, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apptBeauty ab WHERE ab.ApptID = a.ApptID) THEN 'grooming' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apptFoster af WHERE af.ApptID = a.ApptID) THEN 'foster' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apptMedical am WHERE am.ApptID = a.ApptID) THEN 'medical' ELSE 'unknown' END as serviceType FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN store s ON a.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.EmpID = e.EmpID ORDER BY a.CreateTime DESC

SELECT a.ApptID as apptId, a.ApptTime as apptTime, a.ApptStatus as apptStatus, a.CreateTime as createTime, p.PetName as petName, u.UserName as userName, u.Phone as userPhone FROM appointment a INNER JOIN pet p ON a.PetID = p.PetID INNER JOIN `user` u ON a.UserID = u.UserID WHERE a.StoreID = #{storeId} AND a.ApptStatus = '待服务' ORDER BY a.CreateTime DESC

SELECT o.OrderID as orderId, o.ApptID as apptId, o.TotalAmount as totalAmount, o.PayStatus as payStatus, o.PayMethod as payMethod, o.PayTime as payTime, o.OrderCreateTime as orderCreateTime, u.UserName as userName, u.Phone as userPhone, p.PetName as petName FROM `order` o INNER JOIN appointment a ON o.ApptID = a.ApptID INNER JOIN pet p ON a.PetID = p.PetID INNER JOIN `user` u ON a.UserID = u.UserID WHERE a.StoreID = #{storeId} ORDER BY o.OrderCreateTime DESC
